Increases in serum potassium concentration, including hyperkalemia, have been reported with use of NSAIDs, even in some patients without renal impairment.

dfi_rules.mechanism_summary:
7.4 Effect of Antacids
Because antacids may interfere with the absorption of anticholinergic agents including dicyclomine hydrochloride, simultaneous use of these drugs should be avoided.
dfi_rules.clinical_consequence: From the DRUG INTERACTIONS section of the dicyclomine label. Extracted automatically; not clinically reviewed.
dfi_rules.actionable_warning: Avoid taking these together unless your prescriber says otherwise.
